what: Pybricks MicroPython (SPIKE Prime hub API) compiled to WebAssembly on the Brickwright wasm HAL

toolchain.emcc: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.6 (ce75e06884093bcefb86a6b8fd56a5d62a4cc245)

dependency_elimination.strategy: MIT caller sources converted to explicit MicroPython API calls; no replacement helper header

contract_only_implementation.process: Two fresh agents with fork_turns=none, contract-only input directories, explicit tool/file access restrictions, reviewer integration after delivery.
limitations: Instruction-enforced access restrictions; no OS filesystem jail.
No claim about model pretraining knowledge.
This process does not validate the earlier PR #508 authorship claim.

provenance_review.status: documented contract-only replacement; previous PR #508 remains unverified
provenance_review.claim_scope: fresh agent contexts, recorded input/tool restrictions and separate reviewer integration; no OS filesystem jail or assertion about model training data
